title: zig build test-integration: pg_advisory_lock acquisition fails with ServerError under parallel test runs due to lock_timeout/statement_timeout interaction
scope: tests/integration/helpers.zig (4 pg_advisory_lock brackets); scripts/run-test-integration.{ps1,sh} (-j default); migrations/migrate.zig (pool_size). No production code path affected.
description: zig build test-integration failed non-deterministically with PgError.ServerError when the test seed caused many binaries to concurrently queue for pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('bpm_test_migrations_public')). Root cause: lock_timeout='90s' (set by the test harness) and statement_timeout='60s' (set globally) were both in effect during the advisory lock WAIT call. PostgreSQL applies the stricter of the two; effective cap was 60s. With -j8 and 8 binaries queueing, the 2nd-8th binaries hit the 60s cap and returned PgError.ServerError instead of waiting their turn. Prior fix in ISS-0665 only raised lock_timeout to 300s; statement_timeout remained at 60s and continued to cap the wait. The fix required zeroing BOTH timeouts before each pg_advisory_lock acquire and restoring them after the lock is held.
disposition: Test infrastructure only; no production code path affected. Fix: wrap all 4 pg_advisory_lock call sites in helpers.zig with SET lock_timeout=0 / SET statement_timeout=0 before acquire and SET lock_timeout / SET statement_timeout to prior values after the lock is held. Lowered default -j from 8 to 4. Raised migration pool_size from 2 to 4.

pre_existing_issues_revealed.description: TC-RG-01/TC-RG-02 baseline drift: main T010=117 BLOCKERs but GH-512 snapshot expects 116. Snapshot stale after WF02-batch-0 commit 0d9041b5 added a new test file.
iss205/iss203/iss106/env01/sch02 test binaries fail non-deterministically under -j4 due to public-schema table write conflicts.

resolution.details: All 4 pg_advisory_lock brackets in tests/integration/helpers.zig (runMigrations, runMigrationsForSchema x2, TestHarness.init) now execute SET lock_timeout=0 and SET statement_timeout=0 immediately before the pg_advisory_lock acquire, then restore both to their prior values immediately after the lock is held. scripts/run-test-integration.{ps1,sh} default -j cap lowered from 8 to 4. Migration pool_size raised from 2 to 4 to reduce lock-holder duration. Verified SE=0 across seeds 0x3236dff and 0x939cd4a9 in the 5-run acceptance gate.

prevention: Any future SET <timeout> in the test harness that wraps a blocking pg advisory lock call must also zero statement_timeout. PostgreSQL applies min(lock_timeout, statement_timeout, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout) to every statement including blocking lock acquires.

When running zig build test-integration with high concurrency (-j8), advisory lock contention is expected for shared schemas. Always use -j4 or lower as the default and document this in scripts/run-test-integration.* prominently.
